# Synthetic face fixtures (F2)

These people DO NOT EXIST. Both images are crops of the sample collage
published by the SFHQ dataset (github.com/SelfishGene/SFHQ-dataset,
StyleGAN2-generated; its README: "Since all images in this dataset are
synthetically generated there are no privacy issues or license issues").
`person_a_dim.jpg` is `person_a.jpg` re-cropped and darkened here — a
kiosk frame is never the enrollment frame, and the matcher must still
clear the threshold across that gap.

Never replace these with photographs of real people: the suite runs
everywhere the repo goes, and a real face committed as test data would be
exactly the biometric-handling failure the feature is designed against.
